posts.title: Affordable Web Design in London: What Your Budget Actually Gets You
posts.description: A lot of the rebuilds I take on start the same way. Someone paid as little as they could for a WordPress site a few years ago, it got hacked, and now it's broken, blacklisted or both. By the time I've rebuilt it, they've spent roughly double what a decent site would have cost in the first place. That's why I'm wary of the word "cheap". posts.title: Do You Need a Local Web Designer?
posts.description: If you've typed "web designer near me" into Google, you're not alone. It's one of the most common ways people start looking. But does your web designer actually need to be local? The short answer: usually not. What matters far more is the quality of their work and how well they communicate.
